mapper.insert: INSERT INTO professional_group_member ( department_id, keshi, group_path, person_type, name, academic_position, talent_title, roles, resume_text, resume_file_path, gcp_cert_path, practice_cert_path, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{keshi}, #{groupPath}, #{personType}, #{name}, #{academicPosition}, #{talentTitle}, #{roles}, #{resumeText}, #{resumeFilePath}, #{gcpCertPath}, #{practiceCertPath}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id AS departmentId, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, person_type AS personType, name, academic_position AS academicPosition, talent_title AS talentTitle, roles, resume_text AS resumeText, resume_file_path AS resumeFileUrl, gcp_cert_path AS gcpCertUrl, practice_cert_path AS practiceCertUrl, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime FROM professional_group_member WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND group_path = #{groupPath} ORDER BY create_time DESC
